HOW TO EDIT: Change a value on the right, keep the quote marks exactly as they are, then press Commit changes. New players start with these settings; anyone who has already played keeps their own. The allowed values are listed in ALLOWED VALUES below. A value that is not allowed is simply ignored.

ALLOWED VALUES.size: Grid Size: S = Small, M = Medium, L = Large
ALLOWED VALUES.hand: Letters in Hand: 5, 6, 7 or 8 (no quote marks)
ALLOWED VALUES.timer: Timer: 0 = Untimed; per TURN t30 (Blitz), t60, t120, t180, t240, t300; per GAME g120, g180, g300, g600, g900 (seconds)
ALLOWED VALUES.scoring: Scoring: classic, flat, finisher (Word Finisher), combo (Combo Chain), bounty
ALLOWED VALUES.bonus: Bonus Squares: fixed, floating, both, off
ALLOWED VALUES.grid: Grid Colors: a = Board, a2 = Inked, a3 = Inked Blue, a4 = Painted, b = Bold
